title: Primus TorchTitan vs upstream main
scope: Current TorchTitan bundled in Primus vs upstream pytorch/torchtitan origin/main.

integration.integration_model: third_party/torchtitan + Primus outer adapter / trainer / patches

highlights: Primus advanced the torchtitan pin from 5fb7cc2e (v0.1.0) to 73a0e697 (the tagged v0.2.2 release) in PR #871 (merged 2026-07-17).
The pin now sits on a maintained tagged release, but upstream main has advanced 741 commits (698 files, +123580/-35965) past v0.2.2.
Primus has a non-trivial outer integration layer with direct dependencies on upstream internal paths.

dashboard_summary.headline: TorchTitan is pinned to the tagged v0.2.2 release and is 741 commits behind upstream main.
why_it_matters: Primus bumped the pin from v0.1.0 (5fb7cc2e) to the v0.2.2 tag (73a0e697) in PR #871 on 2026-07-17.
The pin is now a maintained tagged release rather than an unreleased mainline commit.
Upstream main is 741 commits ahead of v0.2.2, a 698-file diff, so a further sync is still a substantial change.
Primus trainer, adapter, and patch layers directly depend on upstream internal paths.
feature_deltas: New model families: Kimi K2 (kimi_k2_7) and Qwen 3.5
graph_trainer, rl, transformers_modeling_backend, and torchft experiments
DeepEP v2 cudagraphable APIs and minimal_async_ep kernels
Remote fsspec (gs://) checkpoint paths and mxfp8 MoE ep=1
dependency_deltas: Pin now matches upstream v0.2.2 torch/torchao release anchors (torch-2.12.0.dev20260220+cu126).
Upstream main has continued to advance nightly torch/torchao and CI dependencies since v0.2.2.
Tokenizer download support for newer transformers/hub versions landed after the pin.
integration_risks: Primus trainer imports torchtitan.train.Trainer and torchtitan.tools.logging.
Turbo attention patches reference upstream llama3, llama4, deepseek_v3, and qwen3 internals.
FP8 and MX patches depend on torchtitan.components.quantization.float8/mx and torchtitan.protocols.model_converter.
MoE grouped-mm patch depends on torchtitan.models.moe.moe.
